mapper.delete: delete from idevelop_check_task_device where is_deleted = 0 and task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select count(id) as no_check_num from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '1' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select count(id) as is_check_num from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '0' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select count(id) as pys from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '2' and dispose_result = '1' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select count(id) as py from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '2' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select count(id) as pk from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '3' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select count(id) as pks from idevelop_check_task_device where check_status = '3' and dispose_status = '1' and task_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select receive_unit as dept,count(*) as num from idevelop_check_task_device where (check_status = '2' or check_status = '3') group by receive_unit
